subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR shadow-lineage architecture as the long-term path for https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/2037, and how should it compose with the narrower identity and cache fix in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: The patch is internally coherent and reversible, but choosing a multi-PR accounting architecture, stack order, and overlap policy is repository product and maintenance intent rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Adopt the shadow stack
options.body: Merge the foundation first, reconcile the narrower identity and cache work, then land this rebased integration after exact-head runtime proof while keeping legacy totals authoritative.

options.title: Prefer narrow fixes
options.body: Land only the smaller proven identity, cache, and containment changes and close the lineage stack until a remaining production failure demonstrates the larger architecture is necessary.

options.title: Continue validation only
options.body: Keep the stack open but unmerged until more independent retained-history corpora establish day-level accuracy and predictable cold and warm performance.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shadow stack
recommendation.body: Merge the foundation first, reconcile the narrower identity and cache work, then land this rebased integration after exact-head runtime proof while keeping legacy totals authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner merged and refined the current fork-accounting behavior and is best positioned to choose the permanent scanner architecture and landing order.
